Changes for 高山棋局: use the light-piece silhouettes for both sides;
white fill changed to ivory, black fill changed to charcoal, outlines softened.
These modified SVG assets remain licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.
The SVG files alongside this notice are their complete editable source.

King artwork (wK.svg and bK.svg): angular geometry redrawn for 高山棋局.
The king uses a solid cross, faceted crown and stepped pedestal, with the
same ivory/charcoal palette. These SVG files are also GPL-2.0-or-later.
